tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate of similar nature of work such as providing water supply scheme/Project, a single work a value 50% of the amount put to tender in the prescribed Format from the competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the original certificated and attach the scanned file to the tender. The original certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Tenders.(Work indent number should be mentioned in work done certificate). Quantity wise detail to be furnished as per bid document.
The Tenderer should possess valid registration of Class III and above with PWD Department
